name: spotlight
label: Spotlight (one stage, costume changes)
about: One choreography on one dark stage under a single spotlight; the dancer's outfit and identity change on the beat, faster as the section builds, with motion trails. Modelled on the Eat It edit.

casting.keep: Keep the exact same pose, body position, arm and leg positions, camera angle, framing and proportions. Full body visible. Give the person a completely different face and hair from the original. No glasses. Photorealistic.
